title: SB 98 (2023-2024 Wisconsin Legislature, regular session): verifying citizenship of individuals on the official voter registration list and contents of operator's licenses and identification cards.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id) not stated.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule)
(section) s. 5.056 / 5.057 (new): Elections Commission citizenship verification
(quote) The elections commission shall verify the citizenship of all electors on the official registration list as soon as practicable after the effective date of this subsection using the information provided by the department of transportation under s. 5.056. 4.
(section) s. 343.17 (3) (a) 16. (new): legend on license or ID card
(quote) If the person is not a U.S. citizen, the legend “Not valid for voting purposes” or another readily recognizable indication that the license may not be accepted for voter identification purposes. 3.

(note) Off this topic: the bill sets no ID or citizenship-proof rule.
